Hook-2.text: Nobody keeps up with all of it.

Hook-3.text: So it all comes to you, in one place.

Layers-0.text: Everything that needs your decision, from every project, in one feed, most important first.

Layers-1.text: Nothing moves forward without your yes.

Layers-2.text: Behind it, Momentum understands each project, and keeps it consistent.

Layers-3.text: AI does the work: planned, done and checked.

Layers-4.text: What it finishes comes back to you, ready to read.

Swipe-0.text: Swipe right to approve, and the work goes ahead.

Swipe-1.text: Swipe left to send it back, with what should change.

Swipe-2.text: Or pull up, and ask about it.

Loop-0.text: Work starts on its own, on a schedule, or when something happens.

Loop-1.text: It gets done, and written up for you.

Loop-2.text: Every change is checked before it counts.

Loop-3.text: Then it reaches you, and you decide.

Loop-4.text: For every project, all at once.

Graph-0.text: One project: dozens of files no one wants to read.

Graph-1.text: Momentum turns them into short cards.

Graph-2.text: Each card is a goal, a decision, a policy, a feature.

Graph-3.text: Ask a question, and the answer comes from the cards.

Graph-4.text: Approve a card, and it is verified.

Graph-5.text: If anything changes it, it comes back to you.

Measure-0.text: When work is finished, you read one card, not a pile of changes.

Measure-1.text: And you see how well each project is understood.

Resolve-0.text: When two documents disagree, Momentum notices.

Resolve-1.text: It suggests a fix, best option first.

Resolve-2.text: One swipe, and they agree again.

Schedule-0.text: Day and night, your projects keep moving.

Schedule-1.text: When your feed is full, everything waits for you.

Schedule-2.text: Never more work than you can review.

Learn-0.text: You ask for the same thing again and again.

Learn-1.text: Momentum notices, and proposes making it the rule.

Learn-2.text: It applies everywhere. You still have the last word.

Line-0.text: Decide how much reaches you, and how much runs at once.

Line-2.text: Momentum. Open source, on your own machine. Your attention, where it pays.
